description: Code review. This means: someone checks new code. The checker did not write the code. He looks for mistakes. He asks: is the code clear and safe? Only after the check does the code join the project. Today an AI often writes the code. Then a human checks the changes. An AI can also help with checking. But the responsibility stays with the human.
example: The AI builds a login form. A second AI checks the code. It finds a problem: the password can be read in the log file. You look at it. You have the mistake fixed. Only then does the code join the project.
